newsitem.title: NIGER: World Bank approves $20 million credit for Niger.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $20 million credit for Niger.

text.p: The World Bank has approved a $20 million credit for urban infrastructure projects in Niger, following a visit by a joint IMF-World Bank mission to review Niger's economic performance, a government statement said.
It said the credit would come from the International Development Association, the World Bank's soft loans arm.

This month's IMF and World Bank mission gave a positive assessment of Niger's performance in the first year of an $80 million Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility agreed last June and said the second tranche of $26 million would be released soon.
